the mental health, social, and organizational models are applicable to the health, education and business centers, respectively, and that the social action model was most generally applicable.
the mental health model is most applicable in the health sector, the phenomenological model in education, the organizational model in business, and the social action model in general.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
community psychology is a dynamic field of practice, which is not yet fully developed and is still evolving.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the social action model was most applicable across the various centers in the Zuland Community Psychology project, and that the mental health, organizational, and phenomenological approaches were most applicable in the health, business, and education centers, respectively.

the mental health model is most applicable to the health sector; the social action model is most applicable in a community context; the organizational model is most applicable for a business context; the ecological model is most applicable at the level of the community and the phenomenological model is most applicable when working with individuals.

the mental health model is most applicable to individual and group psychological problems, the phenomenological model is most useful in terms of understanding the lived experience of community members, the social action model is most useful for social action, the organizational model is most applicable for organizational development and the ecological model is most useful to understand the interaction between the individual, the group, and the environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mental health, social change, and organizational models are most appropriate for the Zululands of the world.
community psychology models are not necessarily applicable across different contexts.
community psychology models are not mutually exclusive but are complementary and can be used in combination.
